title: cachegen input configuration
description: Sparse statement of intent for one cache instance. Every field here is a decision a person makes. Derived geometry does not appear in this file; it appears in the elaborated output. See VOCABULARY.md for the checks this schema cannot express.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the file targets. Major bump means breaking.

name.description: Instance name. Drives module and file names: <name>.sv, <name>_pkg.sv, tb_<name>.sv. Must be a legal SystemVerilog identifier.

description.description: Free text. Carried into the emitted file headers and datasheet. Not interpreted.

cache_type.description: Determines which policy fields apply and which datapath is emitted. icache is read-only: no dirty bits, no merge, no writeback.

level.description: Cache level. Informational for emission; affects default naming only.

capacity_bytes.description: Total data capacity. Must be a power of two (checked by the tool, not by this schema).

line_bytes.description: Cache line size. Sets the offset field width.

banks.description: Independent data array banks. 1 means a single array. Banking permits concurrent fill and access.

indexing.description: PIPT indexes with the physical address and serializes translation ahead of the array read. VIPT indexes with the virtual address so the array read and the TLB lookup proceed together.

va_bits.description: Virtual address width. Sv39 -> 39, Sv48 -> 48, Sv57 -> 57. Required when indexing is VIPT.

pa_bits.description: Implemented physical address width. Sets the tag width together with index and offset.

page_bytes.description: Base page size. Bounds the VIPT index+offset budget. Superpages only relax the constraint, so size against the base page. Required when indexing is VIPT.

alias_policy.description: Behaviour when the VIPT index reaches above the page offset. forbid is the only value implemented: the tool rejects such a configuration. Other strategies are out of scope; see VOCABULARY.md exclusions.

read_miss.description: allocate installs the line on a read miss. no_allocate forwards without installing.

write_miss.description: Write miss handling. Must be absent when cache_type is icache.

write_hit.description: write_back marks the line dirty and defers the store to eviction. write_through issues it immediately. Must be absent when cache_type is icache.

replacement.description: Victim selection among valid ways. An invalid way is always preferred over the replacement pick, in all policies.

critical_word_first.description: Forward the requested beat to the core as it arrives rather than waiting for the full line. Meaningless when the line arrives in one beat.

mshrs.description: Miss status holding registers. 0 emits a blocking FSM: one miss outstanding, the pipeline stalls. Any positive value emits non-blocking control with that many concurrent misses.

mshr_targets.description: Secondary misses merged onto one MSHR entry. 1 means no merging. Required when mshrs is greater than 0.

victim_buffer_entries.description: Fully associative buffer holding recently evicted lines. 0 omits it.

fill_buffer_entries.description: Staging entries for in-flight refill data ahead of the array write. 0 writes the array directly from the refill bus.

core_read_width_bits.description: Width returned to the core per access. For an icache this is the fetch bundle, not a word.

core_write_width_bits.description: Width accepted from the core per store. Must be absent when cache_type is icache.

refill_width_bits.description: Width of the fill bus from the next level. Line size divided by this gives the beat count.

next_level_name.description: Name of the level this cache misses to. Informational; appears in port comments and the datasheet.

invalidate_all.description: Emit a single-cycle mass invalidate. Required for fence.i on an icache. Cheap only because valid bits are flops rather than SRAM.

invalidate_line.description: Emit a single-line invalidate by address.

flush_all.description: Emit a walk that writes back every dirty line. Meaningless on a read-only or write-through cache.

profile.description: House style backend. pacino applies the project rules: 80 columns, 2-space indent, clk/rstn, one module per file, file-scope package imports with defines before structs, always_comb over chained assign, ASCII comments. generic applies none of these.

emit.description: Artifacts to produce. Emitting rtl without pkg is rejected. Emitting tb without vectors produces a testbench with no golden data.

output_dir.description: Root for emitted files. Subdirectories rtl/, tb/, tests/ follow the project layout.

sram_model.description: How array storage is emitted. bw_ram instantiates the project library module and its substitution boundary. inferred emits a behavioral array directly. macro emits a wrapper with a named vendor cell left unbound.

macro_name.description: Vendor cell to instantiate. Required when sram_model is macro.

verification_params.description: Leave a small number of parameters live in the emitted RTL so a reduced-geometry instance can be built for simulation. Fully baked output cannot be shrunk, which makes exhaustive array tests intractable.

golden_vectors.description: Produce reference array images and an expected capture stream from the C++ model, for the testbench to compare against at test end.

directed_tests.description: Directed tests to emit. Tests inapplicable to the cache_type are rejected rather than silently dropped.

assertions.description: Emit SVA for the mechanical invariants: one-hot way hit, no fill into a valid way without eviction, MSHR index in range, no tag write without a valid write.
